title: IFRA President joins IFEAT Bangkok panel on supply chain resilience
summary: Alexander Mohr PhD, President of IFRA , joined a panel at the IFEAT conference in Bangkok on the indicators that determine whether supply chains hold up under pressure.

extraction.key_fact: IFRA 회장이 방콕 IFEAT 콘퍼런스에서 공급망 회복력을 주제로 한 토론에 참여했다.
